## What is still open
- PR #247 awaits Maya's approval: she'll approve once CI is green, and she wants the number of dropped Orbitly events for Thursday's call with them — you have it: ~1.18M [2][1]
- Once #247 is merged and deployed, run the replay from landing for Orbitly (~1.18M events, ~40 min) and Zest from 13/11, then check that the dedupe drop counter for Orbitly stays near zero [1]
- The note to the iOS team is still to send: kestrel-ios 3.2.1 must go back to UUIDs for `event_id`, or this will happen again [1]
- Before Friday's incident review (20/11), you're on the hook to add an alert when the ingest dead-letter queue goes above 1,000 messages [7]

## What changed
- The 12/11 postmortem is final; Noa will present it at Friday's incident review, action items are in the Fathom notes [3]
- Zest confirmed their dashboards are complete again and is closing their Zendesk ticket [6]
- CI and the Dockerfile now run Go 1.23.4 (merged, no code change) [4]

## What you did
- You traced Orbitly's ~8% iOS funnel drop to #240's dedupe: the iOS SDK 3.2.0 sends `event_id` as a per-session counter instead of a UUID, so ~1.18M legitimate Orbitly events (and 3,812 Zest pilot ones) were dropped since 13/11 [1]
- You opened PR #247, keying the dedupe on (project, device, event_id) — genuine replays are still caught — with Maya as reviewer [1][2]
